text: Online, the game runs two separate clocks. Local time belongs to your save: it runs while you play, pauses offline and advances with resting, travel, jail and training (governing your quests, effects, hunger, diseases, leases and guilds). Server time runs continuously in real time across the realm (1 game day = 1 real hour) regardless of rest — governing the sky, time of day, moons and world events. Offline, both clocks stay synced.
